summary: The note surveys how schools in late 2023 are using outdoor education to build sustainable school communities. It covers outdoor learning spaces, AR nature trails, community gardens, net-zero school buildings, climate resilience programs, mindfulness in nature, and partnerships with Indigenous communities. It concludes that these trends signal a lasting shift toward environmentally literate, socially responsible learners.
one_line: Schools in late 2023 are making outdoor education a cornerstone of sustainability through living classrooms, AR trails, gardens, green buildings, climate programs and Indigenous partnerships.
key_facts: On September 15, 2023, Principal Angela Hartford of Sunnyside Elementary unveiled the school's "Living Classroom," a green space used for biology, science, geography, art and physical education.
As of October 2023, augmented reality (AR) is being used to bridge the digital world and the natural environment in outdoor learning.
Jacob Turner, an educator at Forest Hill High School, says the school's AR trails let students use devices to engage with forest elements and species.
Linda Roberts, a sustainability advocate and parent, spearheaded the community garden at Valley Middle School, launched on October 31, 2023.
Produce from school community gardens often goes to school cafeterias and to local families in need.
Evergreen Academy opened on November 20, 2023, with a net-zero energy building featuring solar panels, rainwater harvesting systems and natural ventilation.
Principal Michael Johnson describes Evergreen Academy's building as "a 3D textbook on sustainability."
Superintendent Emily White of the Anderson School District started a climate resilience program on December 1, 2023, involving tree planting, water conservation projects and community workshops.
A district-wide initiative launched in September 2023 begins each school day with a "mindful moment" in nature.
In fall 2023, the Riverbend School District partnered with the local Aboriginal community to integrate traditional farming techniques and ecological wisdom into outdoor education.
Climate resilience programs teach students to assess risks and develop strategies for disaster preparedness and adaptation.
